name: 61114 · Rockford, IL
findings: ZIP 61114 (Rockford) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61114 (Rockford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61114 (Rockford) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
